projects.title: Finance Operations Dashboard
projects.description: A responsive analytics dashboard for scanning finance metrics, filtering records, and presenting operational performance clearly.
projects.challenge: Dense business data needed to feel readable, fast, and decision-friendly.
projects.solution: Built a dashboard-style UI structure with metric cards, filtering states, and clear visual hierarchy.
projects.impact: Improves reporting flow and reduces time spent searching through operational records.

projects.title: Inventory API Platform
projects.description: A REST API foundation for products, stock changes, users, and transaction history with relational database structure.
projects.challenge: Inventory data needed predictable endpoints and a database model that could scale into dashboards or mobile apps.
projects.solution: Designed route groups, normalized tables, validation paths, and clean server-side responsibilities.
projects.impact: Creates a stable backend foundation for future product and reporting interfaces.

projects.title: Secure Notes Mobile App
projects.description: A cross-platform notes app concept focused on private content, simple organization, local persistence, and fast mobile UX.
projects.challenge: The app needed to feel lightweight while still respecting user privacy and local data handling.
projects.solution: Mapped mobile-first screens, local storage flow, private note states, and simple interaction patterns.
projects.impact: Shows practical mobile thinking and secure local data design.

projects.title: Developer Portfolio Platform
projects.description: A deployable portfolio platform for presenting engineering capability, selected work, technical stack, and contact paths.
projects.challenge: The site needed to communicate technical credibility quickly and look modern on all devices.
projects.solution: Built a strong tech-forward interface with reusable data, project sections, SEO metadata, and Vercel-ready build output.
projects.impact: Improves first impression for recruiters, clients, and collaborators.
